newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS -- Buyers focus on AEX-call options.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS -- Buyers focus on AEX-call options.

text.p: Buying interest on the European Option Exchange focused on calls on Monday, in contrast to much of last week's action which saw a balance between calls and puts, dealers said.

AEX-options today were the main attraction, with the December options approaching Friday's expiry date. Dealers said it was positive for the share market that market players were turning to call options again and demand was increasing.
Over one-third of all business on the EOE was done in index-linked options, but volumes were also reasonably high in ABN AMRO, ING and Hoogovens.
Investors were willing to pay nearly double the premium for the (620 strike) December AEX call options on Monday compared to last Friday, when the premium was 2.0 guilders at the close.
"The progress made in Dublin last Friday on a stability pact for EU-member boosted trade," said one dealer.
He added investors were likely to show a greater interest in European markets as result of the progress made in Dublin.
The stronger dollar was another positive ingredient for the market. -- Amsterdam newsdesk +31 20 504 5000
